headline: Evening: the after-close earnings fade can now start without any live-code change (a checked earnings-timing classifier, 89% precision); the compass card's move-size line now passes with volatility scaling.
bullets: AMC classifier: news alone was only 58% precise once checked on every name; combined with the live job's pre-open earnings list it is 89% precise, 76% recall, before the open.
FAMC (fade after-close reporters' gaps) starts tracking from its first reaction session; nightly health check on the classifier.
Compass size band: scaling by today's range (fitted on train) fixes the volatility drift (validation t -4.48; coverage 77-81% in every volatility third) - added to the COMPCAL decision.
Option flow (first-30-min call share) closed by its kill line: right sign, too small (0.035 ATR, t 1.05).
No owner replies yet on COMPCAL or the earnings-timing request.
next: Observer builds the nightly earnings-timing list; Builder runs FAMC nightly; Scout picks a fresh direction source; COMPCAL addendum to the owner.
